What is unit transfer daya?

In this glossary, unit transfer daya refers to: A hydraulic unit that enables power transfer between two separate hydraulic systems without mixing their fluids.

How is unit transfer daya used in aviation?

Definition

A hydraulic unit that enables power transfer between two separate hydraulic systems without mixing their fluids.

Operational example

Power Transfer Unit operating to balance hydraulic pressure between systems after engine shutdown.
